meta.name: intelligence-collection-disciplines
meta.description: Run competitive research like an intelligence agency: eight collection disciplines (OSINT to MASINT), signal-to-inference chains, and fusion. Use when one-source research isn't enough.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 像情报机构一样开展多源竞争调研
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果单一来源研究总让你觉得不够深入。
copy.tagline_en: Run competitive research with agency-grade collection and fusion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if single-source research feels too shallow for your decisions.

howto.what: 启用后，Claude 会像情报机构一样做竞争调查：从八种公开信息来源收集信号，把每个线索转成有依据的推断，再交叉验证合并成结论，供产品决策参考。
howto.when: 当你要研究竞争者、市场或合作方，且单一渠道的信息不够时触发；调用时需说明研究谁、怀疑什么动向、以及结果将影响什么决策。

say.text: 我怀疑对手在转向平台模式，用这个技能找证据。
say.note: 会启动多学科交叉验证。

say.text: 研究一下欧洲物流软件市场，带上 NAICS 代码。
say.note: 会生成 TAM/ICP 等分析产物。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude runs competitive research like an intelligence agency: it collects signals across eight public-information disciplines, turns each into bounded inferences, and fuses them into defensible conclusions for product decisions.
howto.when_en: Trigger when one-source research isn't enough for a competitor/market question. Fill target, suspected move, and decision; if decision is blank, it stops and asks.

say_en.text: I suspect a competitor is going platform — find evidence.
Map the European logistics software market using NAICS codes.
